articles.title: Rats Can Make Friends with Robot Rats
articles.topic: 老鼠会与机器鼠交朋友：其对社交信号的敏感度超出预期
articles.source: 2020 年考研英语（二）Text 1 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: Rats and other animals need to be highly attuned to social signals from others so they can identify friends to cooperate with and enemies to avoid.
sentences.cn: 老鼠等动物必须要对同类发出的社交信号高度敏感，这样它们才能分辨哪些是可以合作的朋友，哪些是应该避开的敌人。

sentences.en: To find out if this extends to non-living beings, Laleh Quinn at the University of California, San Diego, and her colleagues tested whether rats can detect social signals from robotic rats.
sentences.cn: 为弄清这一敏感性在面对非生命体时是否仍适用，加州大学圣地亚哥分校的拉蕾·奎因及其同事进行了一项试验，观察老鼠是否能够感知机器鼠发出的社交信号。

sentences.en: They housed eight adult rats with two types of robotic rat - one social and one asocial - for four days.
sentences.cn: 研究人员让 8 只成年鼠与 2 只不同类型的机器鼠——一只爱社交，一只不合群——共处一室 4 天。

words.meaning: adj. 不合群的，缺乏社交性的

sentences.en: The robot rats were quite minimalist, resembling a chunkier version of a computer mouse with wheels to move around and colourful markings.
sentences.cn: 这两只机器鼠外形相当简约抽象，就像矮胖版的电脑鼠标，靠轮子四处移动，带有鲜艳的标记。

words.meaning: v. 像，类似（resemble 的现在分词）

sentences.en: During the experiment, the social robot rat followed the living rats around, played with the same toys, and opened cage doors to let trapped rats escape.
sentences.cn: 在试验过程中，社交机器鼠跟随生物鼠们四处走动，玩同样的玩具，还会打开笼门让被困老鼠逃脱。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the asocial robot simply moved forwards and backwards and side to side.
sentences.cn: 在此期间，非社交机器鼠则只是前后、左右来回移动。

sentences.en: Next, the researchers trapped the robots in cages and gave the rats the opportunity to release them by pressing a lever.
sentences.cn: 接下来，研究人员将机器鼠关进笼子，并给老鼠一个按下控制杆解救机器鼠的机会。

sentences.en: Across 18 trials each, the living rats were 52 per cent more likely on average to set the social robot free than the asocial one.
sentences.cn: 在对每只（生物鼠）各 18 次的试验中，生物鼠解救社交机器鼠的几率比解救非社交机器鼠的几率平均高出 52%。

sentences.en: This suggests that the rats perceived the social robot as a genuine social being.
sentences.cn: 这表明老鼠将社交机器鼠看作了真正的社交生物。

words.meaning: v. 感知，认为（perceive 的过去式）
adj. 真正的，名副其实的

sentences.en: They may have bonded more with the social robot because it displayed behaviors like communal exploring and playing.
sentences.cn: 它们可能因先前社交机器鼠表现出集体探险及游戏等行为而与其建立了更强的情感纽带。

words.meaning: v. 建立紧密关系（bond 的过去分词）
v. 探索（explore 的现在分词）

sentences.en: This could lead to the rats better remembering having freed it earlier, and wanting the robot to return the favour when they get trapped, says Quinn.
sentences.cn: 奎因称，这可能会使老鼠们更清楚记起自己之前曾经解救过机器鼠，并希望自己受困时能得到它相应的回报。

sentences.en: "Rats have been shown to engage in multiple forms of reciprocal help and cooperation, including what is referred to as direct reciprocity - where a rat will help another rat that has previously helped them," says Quinn.
sentences.cn: "已有研究表明，老鼠会进行多种形式的互助及合作，其中包括被称为'直接互惠'的行为，即老鼠会帮助之前曾帮助过自己的另一只老鼠，"奎因说道。

sentences.en: The readiness of the rats to befriend the social robot was surprising given its minimal design.
sentences.cn: 出人意料的是，这只社交机器鼠设计如此简陋，老鼠却仍愿意与它交朋友。

sentences.en: The robot was the same size as a regular rat but resembled a simple plastic box on wheels.
sentences.cn: 机器鼠虽与普通老鼠大小相当，外形却像一个带轮子的简易塑料盒。

words.meaning: v. 像，类似（resemble 的过去式）

sentences.en: "We'd assumed we'd have to give it a moving head and tail, facial features, and put a scent on it to make it smell like a real rat, but that wasn't necessary," says Janet Wiles at the University of Queensland in Australia, who helped with the research.
sentences.cn: "我们原以为必须给它加上活动的头和尾巴、面部特征和以假乱真的老鼠气味才行，但结果证明没有必要，"澳大利亚昆士兰大学的珍妮特·怀尔斯说道，她协助了此项研究。

words.meaning: v. 假定，设想（assume 的过去分词）

sentences.en: The finding shows how sensitive rats are to social cues, even when they come from basic robots.
sentences.cn: 该发现表明老鼠对于社交信号非常敏感，即便这些信号来自简单的机器鼠。

sentences.en: Similarly, children tend to treat robots as if they are fellow beings, even when they display only simple social signals.
sentences.cn: 与之相似，儿童也往往将机器人视为同类，即便这些机器人只能发出简单的社交信号。

sentences.en: "We humans seem to be fascinated by robots, and it turns out other animals are too," says Wiles.
sentences.cn: "我们人类似乎被机器人深深吸引，事实证明其他动物也一样，"怀尔斯说道。

questions.stem: Quinn and her colleagues conducted a test to see if rats can ___.
questions.stem_cn: 奎因和同事进行了一项试验，观察老鼠是否能___。

options.A: pick up social signals from non-living rats
options.B: distinguish a friendly rat from a hostile one
options.C: attain sociable traits through special training
options.D: send out warning messages to their fellows

options_cn.A: 接收非生命鼠发出的社交信号
options_cn.B: 分辨一只老鼠是敌是友
options_cn.C: 通过特殊训练掌握社交技能
options_cn.D: 向同伴们发出警告信息

questions.explanation: 首段末句介绍奎因等的研究目标（tested whether）：测试老鼠是否能察觉机器鼠（non-living beings）发出的社交信号，A 正确，pick up...from non-living rats 同义改写 detect...from robotic rats。B、C 均利用①句已知信息干扰（分辨敌友、需否特训是已知/无关内容）；D 将研究目标反向窜改为老鼠是否会"发出"信息。

questions.stem: What did the asocial robot do during the experiment?
questions.stem_cn: 在试验过程中，非社交机器鼠做了什么？

options.B: It played with some toys.
options.C: It set the trapped rats free.

options_cn.B: 它玩了一些玩具。
options_cn.C: 它释放了被困的老鼠。
options_cn.D: 它独自四处移动。

questions.explanation: 由 the asocial robot、during the experiment 定位至第三段末句：非社交机器鼠只是前后、左右移动，D（moved around alone）正确，alone 点明 simply 暗含的对比。A、B、C 均张冠李戴，把社交机器鼠（the social robot）的行为强加于非社交机器鼠。

questions.stem: According to Quinn, the rats released the social robot because they ___.
questions.stem_cn: 奎因指出，老鼠释放社交机器鼠是因为它们___。

options.A: tried to practice a means of escape
options.B: expected it to do the same in return
options.C: wanted to display their intelligence

options_cn.A: 想实践一种脱困的方法
options_cn.B: 希望机器鼠能报以同样的行为
options_cn.C: 想要展示自己的智力
options_cn.D: 认为这是个有趣的游戏

questions.explanation: 第四段③④⑤句分析：老鼠可能与社交机器鼠建立了情感联结，希望将来自己被困时也能得到回报，故愿意施救，B 同义改写末句 wanting the robot to return the favour when they get trapped。A 曲解 pressing a lever 为"实践逃跑方法"；C、D 分别曲解 displayed behaviours、exploring and playing。

questions.stem: Janet Wiles notes that rats ___.
questions.stem_cn: 珍妮特·怀尔斯指出老鼠___。

options.A: can remember other rats' facial features
options.B: differentiate smells better than sizes
options.C: respond more to actions than to looks
options.D: can be scared by a plastic box on wheels

options_cn.A: 可以记住其他老鼠的面部特征
options_cn.B: 更善于区分气味而不是体型大小
options_cn.C: 对行动比对样貌的反应更大
options_cn.D: 会被带轮子的塑料盒吓到

questions.explanation: 第六段 Wiles 用虚拟语气指出：原以为要给机器鼠加上仿真外形老鼠才会亲近它，但"没有必要"，即样貌不重要，其行动足以引起交友意愿，C 正确。A、B、D 均利用 facial features/scent/size/塑料盒等外形词臆测，与"这些特征缺失不妨碍交友"相悖。

questions.stem: It can be learned from the text that rats ___.
questions.stem_cn: 从本文中我们可以知道，老鼠___。

options.A: appear to be adaptable to new surroundings
options.B: are more socially active than other animals
options.C: behave differently from children in socializing
options.D: are more sensitive to social cues than expected

options_cn.A: 似乎很容易适应新环境
options_cn.B: 比其他动物更积极社交
options_cn.C: 在社交方面与儿童表现不同
options_cn.D: 对社交信号的敏感度高于预期

questions.explanation: 第六段 surprising、第七段 how sensitive...even when...共同传达研究者的"惊讶"：老鼠对社交信号的敏感超出预期，D 正确。A 夸大为"适应新环境"；B 捏造与其他动物的比较；C 与第七段②句"老鼠与儿童表现相似"相悖。

articles.title: Why CEOs Actually Deserve Their Salaries
articles.topic: 为何 CEO 理应获得高薪：多角度论证高薪的合理性
articles.source: 2020 年考研英语（二）Text 2 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: It is true that CEO pay has gone up - top ones may make 300 times the pay of typical workers on average, and since the mid-1970s, CEO pay for large publicly traded American corporations has, by varying estimates, gone up by about 500%.
sentences.cn: 的确，首席执行官（CEO）的薪酬上涨了——平均来看，顶级 CEO 的薪酬可能是普通员工薪酬的 300 倍，而且根据各种不同的估计，自上世纪 70 年代中期以来，美国大型上市公司的 CEO 薪酬上涨了约 500%。

sentences.en: The typical CEO of a top American corporation now makes about $18.9 million a year.
sentences.cn: 美国顶级公司的典型 CEO 现在每年能挣到约 1890 万美元。

sentences.en: The best model for understanding the growth of CEO pay is that of limited CEO talent in a world where business opportunities for the top firms are growing rapidly.
sentences.cn: 理解 CEO 薪酬上涨的最佳模型是，全球顶级公司的商业机会在迅速增长，而 CEO 人才紧缺。

sentences.en: The efforts of America's highest-earning 1% have been one of the more dynamic elements of the global economy.
sentences.cn: 美国收入最高的 1% 人群的努力付出一直是全球经济的较强推动力之一。

sentences.en: It's not popular to say, but one reason their pay has gone up so much is that CEOs really have upped their game relative to many other workers in the U.S. economy.
sentences.cn: 尽管这么说不太讨喜，但 CEO 薪酬涨幅如此之大的一个原因是，相对于美国经济中的许多其他工作者来说，CEO 确实提升了工作表现。

words.meaning: 提升了表现，加大了努力

sentences.en: Today's CEO, at least for major American firms, must have many more skills than simply being able to "run the company."
sentences.cn: 如今的 CEO，至少对于美国的大公司来说，必须拥有更多技能，而不仅仅是会"经营公司"而已。

sentences.en: CEOs must have a good sense of financial markets and maybe even how the company should trade in them.
sentences.cn: CEO 必须对金融市场有良好的判断力，甚至可能要熟知公司应该如何在这些市场中从事交易。

sentences.en: They also need better public relations skills than their predecessors, as the costs of even a minor slipup can be significant.
sentences.cn: 相比前任们，他们还需要更厉害的公关能力，因为即使是一个小小的失误，也可能代价惨重。

words.meaning: n. 前任，前辈（predecessor 的复数）

sentences.en: Then there's the fact that large American companies are much more globalized than ever before, with supply chains spread across a larger number of countries.
sentences.cn: 而且，美国大公司的全球化程度空前，供应链遍布更多的国家。

sentences.en: To lead in that system requires knowledge that is fairly mind-boggling.
sentences.cn: 要在这样的体系中发挥领导作用，必须有相当惊人的知识才行。

words.meaning: 在这样的体系中发挥领导作用
adj. 难以置信的，十分惊人的

sentences.en: Plus, virtually all major American companies are becoming tech companies, often with their own research and development.
sentences.cn: 此外，几乎所有的美国大公司都在向科技公司转变，这些公司通常都要自主研发。

sentences.en: And beyond this, major CEOs still have to do all the day-to-day work they have always done.
sentences.cn: 除此之外，大 CEO 仍然要做他们一直在做的所有日常工作。

sentences.en: The common idea that high CEO pay is mainly about ripping people off doesn't explain history very well.
sentences.cn: 人们普遍认为 CEO 的高薪很大程度上是对员工的剥削，但这并不能很好地解释历史。

sentences.en: By most measures, corporate governance has become a lot tighter and more rigorous since the 1970s.
sentences.cn: 从大多数方面来看，公司治理自上世纪 70 年代以来大幅度收紧趋严。

sentences.en: Yet it is principally during this period of stronger governance that CEO pay has been high and rising.
sentences.cn: 然而，CEO 薪酬一直处于高位且持续上涨的趋势恰恰主要出现于强化治理的这段时期。

sentences.en: That suggests it is in the broader corporate interest to recruit top candidates for increasingly tough jobs.
sentences.cn: 这表明，招聘顶尖候选人从事日益艰难的工作符合公司的更广泛利益。

sentences.en: Furthermore, the highest CEO salaries are paid to outside candidates, not to the cozy insider picks, another sign that high CEO pay is not some kind of depredation at the expense of the rest of the company.
sentences.cn: 此外，最高的 CEO 薪资是付给外部候选人的，而非付给那些安逸的内部人选，这也表明 CEO 高薪并不是某种以牺牲公司其他员工利益为代价的掠夺之举。

sentences.en: And the stock market reacts positively when companies tie CEO pay to, say, stock prices, a sign that those practices build up corporate value not just for the CEO.
sentences.cn: 当公司将 CEO 薪酬与股价等因素挂钩时，股市会做出积极反应，这表明这些举措逐步增加公司价值不仅仅是为了 CEO。

words.meaning: 将 CEO 薪酬与……挂钩

questions.stem: Which of the following has contributed to CEO pay rise?
questions.stem_cn: 下列哪项是 CEO 薪酬上涨的原因之一？

options.A: The growth in the number of corporations.
options.B: The general pay rise with a better economy.
options.C: Increased business opportunities for top firms.

options_cn.B: 经济好转，工资普遍上涨。
options_cn.C: 顶级公司的商业机会增多。
options_cn.D: 主要经济体之间的密切合作。

questions.explanation: 第二段①句 The best model 指出：全球顶级公司商机迅速增长而 CEO 人才紧缺，故薪酬上涨，C（Increased 对应 growing rapidly）正确。A 将"商业机会增长"偷换为"公司数量增长"；B、D 由 economy 等词捏造"经济好转致普遍涨薪""经济体密切合作"。

questions.stem: Compared with their predecessors, today's CEOs are required to ___.
questions.stem_cn: 相比前辈们，如今的 CEO 被要求___。

options.A: foster a stronger sense of teamwork
options.B: finance more research and development
options.C: establish closer ties with tech companies

options_cn.B: 资助更多的研发工作
options_cn.C: 与科技公司建立更紧密的联系
options_cn.D: 经营更加全球化的公司

questions.explanation: 第三段④⑤句：美国大公司全球化程度空前，CEO 需在这样的体系中领导（To lead in that system），D 正确。A 把"金融市场判断力"曲解为"团队意识"；B 由 financial 捏造 finance 研发；C 把"大公司在转变为科技公司"曲解为"与科技公司建立联系"。

questions.stem: CEO pay has been rising since the 1970s despite ___.
questions.stem_cn: 上世纪 70 年代以来 CEO 薪酬一直在上涨，尽管___。

options.B: strict corporate governance
options.C: conservative business strategies

options_cn.B: 公司治理严格
options_cn.C: （公司）商业战略较为保守
options_cn.D: （公司）一再收到政府警告

questions.explanation: 第四段②③句为让步转折：70 年代以来公司治理趋严（让步），但 CEO 薪酬恰恰在该时期高企上涨（转折），B 概括让步信息。A 由①句普遍看法过度推断"内部反对"；C 属商业常识臆测；D 把"公司自我治理趋严"曲解为"政府警告"。

questions.stem: High CEO pay can be justified by the fact that it helps ___.
questions.stem_cn: CEO 的高薪有其合理性，因为它有助于___。

options.B: motive inside candidates
options.C: boost the efficiency of CEOs

options_cn.B: 激励内部候选人
options_cn.C: 提高 CEO 的（工作）效率
options_cn.D: 增加公司价值

questions.explanation: 第五段末句：将 CEO 薪酬与股价挂钩等举措 build up corporate value，故高薪合理，D 正确。A 原文未提"巩固地位"；B 与①句"高薪给外部候选人而非内部人选"相悖；C 将"安逸的内部人选"曲解为"提高在任者效率"。

questions.stem: The most suitable title for this text would be ___.
questions.stem_cn: 本文最合适的标题是___。

options.B: CEO Pay: Past and Present
options.C: CEOs' Challenges of Today
options.D: CEO Traits: Not Easy to Define

options_cn.B: CEO 薪酬：过去和现在
options_cn.C: CEO 今日面临的挑战
options_cn.D: CEO 的特质：很难定义

questions.explanation: 全文从"人才稀缺、能力匹配、符合公司利益、提升公司价值"多角度论证 CEO 高薪合理，A（并不过高）最贴合主旨。B 仅涉及薪酬今昔变化未表观点；C、D 由第三段"更多技能"臆断"挑战/难界定"，均偏离"薪酬"这一关注点。

articles.title: It Can't Be Left to Europe's Cities to Clean Up Noxious Air
articles.topic: 不可将治理有毒空气交由欧洲各城市：应由国家政府主导
articles.source: 2020 年考研英语（二）Text 3 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: Madrid was hailed as a public health guiding light last November when it rolled out ambitious restrictions on the most polluting cars.
sentences.cn: 去年十一月，马德里针对污染最严重的汽车正式推出大规模管控措施时，被誉为公共卫生健康的楷模。

sentences.en: Seven months and one election day later, a new conservative city council suspended enforcement of the clean air zone, a first step toward its possible termination.
sentences.cn: 七个月后大选日一过，由保守派掌控的新一届市议会随即中止了"清洁空气区"的执行，迈出了可能导致它被废除的第一步。

words.meaning: v. 使暂停（suspend 的过去式）

sentences.en: Mayor Jose Luis Martinez-Almeida made opposition to the zone a centrepiece of his election campaign, despite its success in improving air quality.
sentences.cn: 尽管"清洁空气区"在改善空气质量方面取得良好效果，但市长何塞·路易斯-马丁内斯-阿尔梅达却将反对它作为竞选运动的核心主张。

words.meaning: n. 最重要的部分，核心

sentences.en: A judge has now overruled the city's decision to stop levying fines, ordering them restored.
sentences.cn: 目前，一名法官推翻了市政府停止收取罚金的决议，责令恢复收取罚金。

words.meaning: v. 否决，推翻（overrule 的过去分词）
v. 恢复（restore 的过去分词）

sentences.en: But with legal battles ahead, the zone's future looks uncertain at best.
sentences.cn: 但是，司法拉锯战在前，"清洁空气区"的未来充其量只能说是前途难卜。

sentences.en: Madrid's back and forth on clean air is a pointed reminder of the limits to the patchwork, city-by-city approach that characterises efforts on air pollution across Europe, Britain very much included.
sentences.cn: 马德里在清洁空气问题上的反反复复显而易见地提醒着我们，欧洲各国（当然也包括英国）这种零碎的、各城市各自为政的空气污染治理举措存在局限性。

words.meaning: n. 拼凑之物，零碎的东西

sentences.en: Among other weaknesses, the measures cities must employ when left to tackle dirty air on their own are politically controversial, and therefore vulnerable.
sentences.cn: 各大城市独力承担污浊空气治理之责，其被迫不得已而采取的措施具有很多薄弱点，其中之一是：会引发政治争议，因而极易招致攻击。

words.meaning: adj. 易受攻击的，脆弱的

sentences.en: That's because they inevitably put the costs of cleaning the air on to individual drivers - who must pay fees or buy better vehicles - rather than on to the car manufacturers whose cheating is the real cause of our toxic pollution.
sentences.cn: 这是因为，这些措施不可避免地将清洁空气的成本加诸司机个人——司机必须为污染付费或者买更好的车——而不是加诸汽车生产商，生产商的舞弊行为才是造成有毒污染的真正原因。

sentences.en: It's not hard to imagine a similar reversal happening in London.
sentences.cn: 不难想象，相似的逆转将在伦敦上演。

sentences.en: The new ultra-low emission zone (Ulez) is likely to be a big issue in next year's mayoral election.
sentences.cn: "超低排放新区（Ulez）"很可能是明年伦敦市长选举的重大议题。

sentences.en: And if Sadiq Khan wins and extends it to the North and South Circular roads in 2021 as he intends, it is sure to spark intense opposition from the far larger number of motorists who will then be affected.
sentences.cn: 如果萨迪克·汗获胜，而且一如他所计划的那样于 2021 年将"超低排放新区"扩展至南北环路，那么一定会激起"届时将受影响的、数量大得多的汽车车主"的强烈反对。

words.meaning: n. 汽车车主，开车的人

sentences.en: It's not that measures such as London's Ulez are useless.
sentences.cn: 并不是说伦敦 Ulez 这类措施无用。

sentences.en: Far from it.
sentences.cn: 恰恰相反。

sentences.en: Local officials are using the levers that are available to them to safeguard residents' health in the face of a serious threat.
sentences.cn: 严重威胁当前，地方官员正在运用他们所能使用的手段来保障居民健康。

words.meaning: n. 手段，方法（lever 的复数）

sentences.en: The zones do deliver some improvements to air quality, and the science tells us that means real health benefits.
sentences.cn: 这些区域确实大大改善了空气质量，而且科学表明，空气质量改善意味着切实的健康收益。

sentences.en: But mayors and councilors can only do so much about a problem that is far bigger than any one city or town.
sentences.cn: 但是，针对这么一个影响范围远超一城一镇的（空气污染）问题，市长们、议员们所能做的也就仅此而已。

sentences.en: They are acting because national governments - Britain's and others across Europe - have failed to do so.
sentences.cn: 他们之所以在行动，是因为各国政府——英国以及所有其他欧洲国家的政府——未能做出行动。

sentences.en: Restrictions that keep highly polluting cars out of certain areas - city centres, "school streets", even individual roads - are a response to the absence of a larger effort to properly enforce existing regulations and require auto companies to bring their vehicles into compliance.
sentences.cn: 此类"禁止高污染汽车进入特定区域（如市中心、学区街道、甚至个别特殊道路）"的限制措施的出台，是因为缺乏更大规模的行动以严格执行现有法规并要求汽车公司生产合规机动车。

words.meaning: n. 限制条例（restriction 的复数）

sentences.en: Wales has introduced special low speed limits to minimise pollution.
sentences.cn: 威尔士公国现已推行特定低速限制以最小化污染。

words.meaning: v. 采用，推行（introduce 的过去分词）

sentences.en: We're doing everything but insist that manufacturers clean up their cars.
sentences.cn: 我们正在竭尽一切所能，却唯独没有坚决要求制造商"清洁"其汽车。

questions.stem: Which of the following is true about Madrid's clean air zone?
questions.stem_cn: 关于马德里"清洁空气区"，以下哪种说法正确？

options.B: It has been opposed by a judge.
options.C: It needs tougher enforcement.
options.D: Its fate is yet to be decided.

options_cn.B: 它已遭到某位法官的反对。
options_cn.C: 它需要更严厉的执行。
options_cn.D: 它的命运尚未确定。

questions.explanation: 首段末句 the zone's future looks uncertain at best，即命运尚未确定，D 正确。A 与③句 its success in improving air quality 相悖；B 把主体搞反（法官推翻市府决定、责令恢复罚金，是支持该区）；C 无中生有"执行不力"。

questions.stem: Which is considered a weakness of the city-level measures to tackle dirty air?
questions.stem_cn: 以下哪项被认为是市级污浊空气治理措施的一个薄弱之处？

options.A: They are biased against car manufacturers.
options.B: They prove impractical for city councils.
options.C: They are deemed too mild by politicians.
options.D: They put the burden on individual motorists.

options_cn.A: 它们对汽车生产商有失公允。
options_cn.B: 对市议会而言，它们不切实际。
options_cn.C: 对政治家而言，它们治理力度过轻。
options_cn.D: 它们将责任加诸机动车车主个人。

questions.explanation: 第三段①②句：市级措施把清洁空气成本加诸车主个人而非罪魁祸首汽车生产商，D 正确。A 将取舍对象对调（不公允对象是车主而非厂商）；B 把"可能失败"曲解为"不切实际"；C 把"引发政治争议、脆弱"曲解为"力度过轻"。

questions.stem: The author believes that the extension of London's Ulez will ___.
questions.stem_cn: 作者认为，扩展伦敦"超低排放新区（Ulez）"会___。

options.B: ensure Khan's electoral success
options.C: improve the city's traffic

options_cn.B: 确保萨迪克·汗选举成功
options_cn.C: 改善城市交通
options_cn.D: 阻碍汽车生产

questions.explanation: 第三段⑤句：若 2021 年将 Ulez 扩展至南北环路，一定会激起众多受影响车主的强烈反对，A 同义改写 spark intense opposition。B 颠倒因果；C 把"改善空气质量"偷换为"改善交通"；D 把影响对象"车主"偷换为"汽车生产商"。

questions.stem: Who does the author think should have addressed the problem?
questions.stem_cn: 作者认为本应由谁来解决这个问题？

options.B: Mayors.
options.C: Councilors.

options_cn.B: 市长。
options_cn.C: 议员。
options_cn.D: 国家政府。

questions.explanation: 第五段②句：市长市议员之所以行动，是因为国家政府未能行动（have failed to do so），可知作者认为本应由国家政府解决，D 正确。A 把"受益居民"偷换为"问题解决者"；B、C 是当前正在补位的主体，非题干"本应负责却缺位"者。

questions.stem: It can be learned from the last paragraph that auto companies ___.
questions.stem_cn: 由末段可知，汽车公司___。

options.B: should be forced to follow regulations
options.C: will upgrade the design of their vehicles
options.D: should be put under public supervision

options_cn.A: 将增加低排放汽车的产量
options_cn.B: 应被强制要求遵守规章制度
options_cn.C: 将升级其机动车设计
options_cn.D: 应被置于公众监督之下

questions.explanation: 末段首末句借"缺乏更大规模行动""竭尽一切却唯独没有要求制造商清洁汽车"两处隐性否定，反向推知应强制汽车公司遵纪守法，B 正确。A、C 只见 require...compliance 却无视 absence，与"厂商舞弊"消极现实相悖；D 望文生义 We're doing everything，误推"公众监督"。

articles.title: Generation Z: Practical, Cautious and Risk-Averse
articles.topic: 职场新人 Z 世代：厌恶风险、追求稳定
articles.source: 2020 年考研英语（二）Text 4 · 原文与答案依据真题及解析 PDF

sentences.en: Now that members of Generation Z are graduating college this spring - the most commonly-accepted definition says this generation was born after 1995, give or take a year - the attention has been rising steadily in recent weeks.
sentences.cn: 由于一些 Z 世代成员——对这代人最普遍接受的定义是出生于 1995 年之后（可有一年出入）——今春即将大学毕业，近几周对他们的关注也在不断增长。

sentences.en: Gen Zs are about to hit the streets looking for work in a labor market that's tighter than it's been in decades.
sentences.cn: Z 世代即将涌入几十年来劳动力最为紧缺的职场，开启求职之旅。

words.meaning: adj. 更紧俏的（劳动力供不应求）

sentences.en: And employers are planning on hiring about 17 percent more new graduates for jobs in the U.S. this year than last, according to a survey conducted by the National Association of Colleges and Employers.
sentences.cn: 一项由美国大学和雇主协会开展的调查显示，在今年的美国，雇主计划比去年多雇佣约 17% 的应届毕业生。

words.meaning: v. 雇佣（hire 的现在分词）

sentences.en: Everybody wants to know how the people who will soon inhabit those empty office cubicles will differ from those who came before them.
sentences.cn: 每个人都想知道，即将占据办公室空隔间的这些人与他们的前辈相比有何不同。

sentences.en: If "entitled" is the most common adjective, fairly or not, applied to millennials (those born between 1981 and 1995), the catchwords for Generation Z are practical and cautious.
sentences.cn: 如果"有权享有"是最常用于形容千禧一代（出生于 1981 至 1995 年间）的词——无论恰当与否——那么描述 Z 世代的关键词就是"讲求实际"和"谨慎小心"。

sentences.en: According to the career counselors and experts who study them, Generation Zs are clear-eyed, economic pragmatists.
sentences.cn: 据职业顾问和研究 Z 世代的专家称，Z 世代是头脑清醒的经济实用主义者。

words.meaning: adj. 头脑清醒的，有洞察力的
n. 实用主义者（pragmatist 的复数）

sentences.en: Despite graduating into the best economy in the past 50 years, Gen Zs know what an economic train wreck looks like.
sentences.cn: 尽管毕业于五十年来最好的经济形势，但 Z 世代了解经济火车失事的惨状。

sentences.en: They were impressionable kids during the crash of 2008, when many of their parents lost their jobs or their life savings or both.
sentences.cn: 2008 年经济崩盘时他们正是敏感的孩子，当时许多父母丢掉了工作或毕生积蓄，甚或二者一并丧失。

words.meaning: adj. 易受影响的（尤指年轻）

sentences.en: They aren't interested in taking any chances.
sentences.cn: 他们对冒险毫无兴趣。

sentences.en: The booming economy seems to have done little to assuage this underlying generational sense of anxious urgency, especially for those who have college debt.
sentences.cn: 蓬勃发展的经济似乎并未减轻这一代人深刻的忧患意识，对于那些背负大学债务的人尤其如此。

sentences.en: College loan balances in the U.S. now stand at a record $1.5 trillion, according to the Federal Reserve.
sentences.cn: 根据美联储的数据，美国大学贷款欠额已达创纪录的 1.5 万亿美元。

sentences.en: One survey from Accenture found that 88 percent of graduating seniors this year chose their major with a job in mind.
sentences.cn: 埃森哲咨询公司一项调查发现，今年毕业的大四学生中，88% 在当初选择专业时已有心目中的工作。

words.meaning: 心中有明确的工作目标

sentences.en: In a 2019 survey of University of Georgia students, meanwhile, the career office found the most desirable trait in a future employer was the ability to offer secure employment (followed by professional development and training, and then inspiring purpose).
sentences.cn: 与此同时，佐治亚大学就业办公室在 2019 年一项针对该校学生的调查中发现，未来雇主最受欢迎的品质是提供稳定工作的能力（其后分别是职业发展及培训、激励人心的企业宗旨）。

sentences.en: Job security or stability was the second most important career goal (work-life balance was number one), followed by a sense of being dedicated to a cause or to feel good about serving the greater good.
sentences.cn: 工作保障或稳定是第二重要的职业目标（最重要的是"工作与生活平衡"），随后是事业奉献感或服务于宏大高尚事业的满足感。

words.meaning: 宏大高尚的事业，更大的公共利益

sentences.en: That's a big change from the previous generation.
sentences.cn: 这和前一代人比起来是一个巨大转变。

sentences.en: "Millennials wanted more flexibility in their lives," notes Tanya Michelsen, Associate Director of YouthSight, a UK-based brand manager that conducts regular 60-day surveys of British youth, in findings that might just as well apply to American youth.
sentences.cn: "千禧一代希望生活有更多的灵活性，"YouthSight 副总监塔尼娅·米切尔森在可能同样适用于美国青年的调查发现中表示（YouthSight 是英国一家品牌管理公司，每 60 天对英国青年展开定期调查）。

sentences.en: "Generation Zs are looking for more certainty and stability, because of the rise of the gig economy.
sentences.cn: "由于零工经济的崛起，Z 世代寻求更多的确定性和稳定性。

sentences.en: They have trouble seeing a financial future and they are quite risk averse."
sentences.cn: 他们难以看到经济前景，极力规避风险。"

words.meaning: 厌恶风险的，规避风险的

questions.stem: Generation Zs graduating college this spring ___.
questions.stem_cn: 今春毕业的 Z 世代___。

options.B: are optimistic about the labor market
options.C: are in favor of office job offers

options_cn.B: 对劳动力市场感到乐观
options_cn.C: 青睐办公室工作的机会
options_cn.D: 得到公众越来越多的关注

questions.explanation: 第一段首句：Z 世代今春毕业，近几周对他们的关注不断增长，D 复现 the attention has been rising steadily。A 由"多招毕业生"臆断"能力受认可"（实为大环境使然）；B、C 分别把"劳动力市场紧缺""将占据办公室"等客观事实歪曲为 Z 世代的主观看法/喜好。

questions.stem: Generation Zs are keenly aware ___.
questions.stem_cn: Z 世代非常明白___。

options.A: what their parents expect of them
options.B: how valuable a counselor's advice is
options.C: what a tough economic situation is like
options.D: how they differ from past generations

options_cn.B: 顾问的建议有多宝贵
options_cn.C: 严酷的经济形势是什么样子
options_cn.D: 他们和前几代人的区别

questions.explanation: 第二段③④句：Z 世代深知经济崩溃的惨状，2008 年危机时他们尚是敏感的孩子、父母失业失财，故 C（what a tough economic situation is like）正确，同义改写 what an economic train wreck looks like。A 强加"父母期待"；B 歪曲"顾问建议"；D 把"与千禧一代不同"曲解为"知道自己与前辈的区别"。

questions.stem: The word "assuage" (Line 9, Para. 2) is closest in meaning to ___.
questions.stem_cn: assuage 一词（第 2 段第 9 行）的含义最接近___。

options.B: define
options.C: maintain

options_cn.B: 定义
options_cn.C: 保持
options_cn.D: 减轻

questions.explanation: 所考词在⑥句，主语"蓬勃经济"与宾语"忧患意识"构成对立，have done little to assuage 应表"难以缓解、对……无效"，故 assuage 意为"减轻"，D 正确。A 方向相反；B、C 与上下文的对立关系不符。

questions.stem: It can be learned from Paragraph 3 that Generation Zs ___.
questions.stem_cn: 由第 3 段可知，Z 世代___。

options.A: give top priority to professional training
options.B: have a clear idea about their future jobs
options.C: care little about their job performance
options.D: think it hard to achieve work-life balance

options_cn.B: 对自己未来工作有清晰的想法
options_cn.C: 对自己的工作表现不以为意
options_cn.D: 认为"工作与生活平衡"很难实现

questions.explanation: 第三段①句：88% 的毕业生在选专业时已有心目中的工作，说明 Z 世代对未来工作有清晰想法，B 正确。A 把培训重要性由"次于工作稳定"窜改为"最优先"；C 过度推断"不重视工作"；D 把"最重视工作生活平衡"窜改为"认为其难实现"。

questions.stem: Michelsen thinks that compared with millennials, Generation Zs are ___.
questions.stem_cn: 米切尔森认为，比起千禧一代，Z 世代___。

options.B: less adventurous
options.C: more diligent

options_cn.B: 不那么爱冒险
options_cn.C: 更勤勉
options_cn.D: 更慷慨

questions.explanation: 第四段③④句 Michelsen 指出：Z 世代寻求确定性与稳定性、极力规避风险（risk averse），B（less adventurous）正确。A 与其"讲求现实"相悖；C、D 把第三段"崇高职业目标"等词曲解为"勤勉""慷慨"，且原文未就此比较两代人。
